subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR add currentAttemptReplayMetadata to the exported embedded attempt result and retry classified empty server_error turns before assistant failover once full-runner proof is posted?
rationale: The code shape appears narrowly correct, but the change affects exported harness result shape, retry/session semantics, and user-visible delivery recovery; automation cannot choose that compatibility and routing policy for maintainers.

options.title: Require proof, then land this shape
options.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then proceed with the current-attempt metadata design if the proof shows recovery without duplicate side effects.

options.title: Accept the risk now
options.body: Treat the current tests and predicate transcript as enough and accept the additive harness-field and retry-ordering risk without additional real setup proof.

options.title: Request a different signal
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want a new attempt-result field and ask for another current-attempt side-effect signal before retry eligibility changes.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then land this shape
